resources.string: Navigation guidance from your Android box to DashCast
Connect this device to the car hotspot. In DashCast, open Satellite device → Pair a device, then enter its code here.
Enter the six-digit code shown in DashCast. You can switch between DashCast and this screen; the code is valid for two minutes.
Enter the six digits shown in DashCast.
Advanced: enter the car IP address
Car IP address shown in DashCast
Enter a local IPv4 address without a port or URL.
no local IPv4 car address is available; check the car hotspot or pair again
Connect this device to the car Wi-Fi hotspot, then try again.
Pairing failed. Check the code or request a new one in DashCast. If needed, enter the car IP address under Advanced.
Saved DashCast ID: %1$s\nCar addresses: %2$s\nCompare this ID with the Satellite page in DashCast. A saved pairing does not mean connected.
Invalid profile or protected storage unavailable.
Pairing saved. You can now start the connection.
Maps can use recognized notification arrows or explicit text. Roundabouts require an explicit exit number. Unknown or conflicting guidance is not sent. ABRP requires explicit text.

If Android says “App was denied access”, open App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then return and enable notification access. This lets DashSat read navigation notifications from your selected source. If the option is missing or disabled, the box firmware may restrict access; the app cannot grant it itself.
Open App info for restricted settings
Unable to open App info. Open Android Settings → Apps → DashSat.
Resume guidance after reboot if transmission was enabled
Enable “Use satellite guidance” in DashCast. Connection and guidance have separate status indicators.
disabled when last checked · enable “Use satellite guidance” in DashCast
the car did not complete the connection in time
DashCast did not confirm the pairing in time
unable to reach the receiver at this address
the receiver certificate could not be verified; check the box date and saved pairing
DashCast rejected the saved pairing; pair again
the receiver rejected the message format
the receiver sent an unsupported response
the connection could not continue; retrying
the connection could not send data in time
Unable to start. Check the profile and permissions, then try again.
This system does not provide the notification access settings screen.

Set up while parked. Start the DashSat connection, choose an app, then Start video sharing. In Android’s sharing dialog, choose that same app; Android decides what is captured. You can then leave CarPlay and open Preview received map in DashCast. The authorized sharing session waits for the viewer. The launch selection does not verify the shared app.

Set up while parked. Start the DashSat connection, choose an app, then Start video sharing. This Android version shares the entire box screen. You can then leave CarPlay and open Preview received map in DashCast; the authorized sharing session waits for the viewer.

Screen sharing may include personal information. Protected content may be blank. Keep interaction on the box or main display. Stop from the notification while another app is open. Hiding the shared app or the DashCast viewer pauses video but keeps screen sharing authorized on this device. Reopen the shared app and viewer to resume; Android must provide a new frame. Connection loss, lock, revocation or Stop ends sharing and requires new Android consent. Guidance remains independent.

Starts at up to 960×540, 15 fps and 1.5 Mbps using a hardware encoder on this device. The car must still decode and display video. Lower car CPU/GPU use requires comparison on your vehicle; it is not guaranteed by connection alone.
Waiting for Android screen sharing permission…
Connected · Android consent required to start; the viewer can open later
Screen sharing paused · open the shared app on this device. Sharing resumes in the same authorized session when Android provides a new frame and DashCast is ready.
Screen sharing paused · open the shared app
Screen sharing active · waiting for DashCast. Return to DashCast and open Preview received map.
Video connected · check the image in DashCast
Connection lost · guidance reconnects separately; new consent required for video
Video stopped or unavailable · check the device and viewer, then grant new consent
Receiver video address unsupported · IPv4 LAN host candidates are required; mDNS, IPv6 and relay addresses are not supported
Unable to start screen sharing. Check Android consent and hardware encoder availability.
Unable to launch that app on this device.
Screen sharing active · sending video to DashCast
Screen sharing active · waiting for DashCast

Check GitHub for a compatible DashSat update. Internet access is required. Downloads use your normal Internet connection. Android asks you to allow installation from this app and confirm the update. Complete setup while parked; installation restarts DashSat.
Updates are checked only when you tap Check for updates.
Update verified. Tap Install update. If Android needs permission, allow this app and return here, then tap Install update again.
Unable to check or verify this update. Check Internet access and free storage, then retry. Unverified APKs cannot be installed.
Unable to open Android installation settings or installer. Check the box firmware settings and try again.
Newest first, for this app process only. Session numbers separate sharing attempts. Earlier events remain visible after switching back from DashCast; they do not confirm the current receiver image.
Connect DashSat to DashCast to send diagnostics.
This DashCast version cannot receive diagnostics.
Send the recent video history over the local connection, then return to DashCast and send a bug report. No Telegram or internet access is needed on this device.

Last transfer: diagnostics received by DashCast. Return to DashCast and send a bug report. The snapshot is historical and kept in memory for up to 24 hours; restarting or resetting DashCast clears it.
DashCast could not accept the diagnostics. Try again.
Diagnostics were not confirmed. Check the connection and try again.
No confirmation from DashCast. Try again.
Video sharing stopped: the encoder could not provide compatible H.264 video. Send diagnostics to DashCast.

While parked, test a synthetic TEST PATTERN through the same video connection. No captured app images are sent during this test. Android still requires screen-sharing consent: choose the selected app and leave it open on the Tbox, then return to DashCast. The test stops after up to 15 seconds of negotiation/transmission, or 60 seconds after consent even without a viewer. It does not prove hardware decoding or lower CPU use. A new consent is required for normal app sharing.
Compatibility test requires a selected app and a connected DashCast with reference-test support. Normal sharing and testing cannot run together.
TEST PATTERN test active · open the viewer in DashCast. App images are not sent. The test ends automatically.
TEST PATTERN compatibility test · stops automatically
Compatibility test ended. Send diagnostics to DashCast. This does not confirm a decoded image; start normal sharing with a new Android consent.
Video test · open the shared app on the Tbox to provide a fresh frame, then return to DashCast. The deadline continues.
